title: Immune gene and protein profiles across blood, cerebrospinal fluid and peripheral nerve in inflammatory neuropathies
description: Public aggregate materials for the revised manuscript dated 16 September 2026. Version 2.3.1 synchronises CSF concentration evidence and assay-type coverage, published nerve interferon and complement evidence, Table 3, revised Figures 3–5, source workbook, supplementary methods and plotting scripts. Different evidence types and correction families are stated explicitly. Supported aggregate statistical results are retained. Individual donor intermediates are excluded. Code is MIT licensed; project-derived data and figures are CC BY 4.0. External sources retain their original terms.
